From: Claire Jensen <claire@novusai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff & next steps

Thanks Logan — great overview on the call today. Aaron and I reviewed the onboarding outline and we think a focused mutual action plan (MAP) will help us align milestones across our infra and product teams.

Big picture asks from our side:
- Week-by-week milestones for the first 90 days (including acceptance criteria)
- Clear owner for each milestone (R/W contact + Redwood PM)
- Risk notes for any gated activities (network prep, data ingest, SSO)

Can you share a draft MAP we can walk through in Tuesday's working session? I attached a short list of our internal dependencies (NovusAI_requirements_v1.xlsx) for reference.

Thanks,
Claire Jensen
Head of Integrations | NovusAI
claire@novusai.com

Attachment: NovusAI_requirements_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovusAI MAP & Onboarding Cadence (Draft + Owners)

Claire — thanks for the clear asks and for sending the dependency list. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Draft_MAP_NovusAI.xlsx) and a short SOW stub. The draft breaks the 90-day plan into six two-week sprints so we can do incremental validation and early acceptance checks. Highlights:

- Sprint 0 (Week 0–2): Network & security prep (Novus IT + Redwood infra). Acceptance: VPN/IP allowlist + SAML test account. Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Novus: Aaron Lee.
- Sprint 1 (Week 3–4): Model selection & perf baseline. Acceptance: baseline run with 50k tokens + perf report. Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / Novus: Data Eng lead.
- Sprint 2 (Week 5–6): Integration + telemetry (API keys, metrics). Acceptance: events visible in console, end-to-end call. Owner: Jasmine Liu (Redwood) / Novus: Platform.
- Sprint 3 (Week 7–8): Reliability & cutover rehearsal. Acceptance: staged failover test. Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Novus: SRE.
- Sprint 4 (Week 9–12): Acceptance & go-live prep. Owner: Team shared; final acceptance checklist included.

I called out gating risks in the draft (networking windows, data transfer SLA, SOC2 evidence timelines). Please review the owners column — Marissa/Ben/Jasmine and I split points so no single person is overloaded.

Next steps:
1) Review the attached draft before Tue 10am PT working session.
2) During the session we'll lock owners and firm dates.
3) I'll publish a finalized MAP and upload a signed SOW link after acceptance.

Attachment: Draft_MAP_NovusAI.xlsx (workbook stub)
Attachment: NovusAI_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF stub)
